A fleet takes a target alone when its strength is at least this multiple of the hostile group around the target, and fleets already on a target with this much strength are left to it. Used only while fleet coordination is on.

A fleet that shares targets goes in and asks for help when it and the fleets already on the target reach this multiple of the group, else it holds until enough fleets pledge. A fleet that does not share goes alone from this multiple. Used only while fleet coordination is on.
When the fleets on a target fall below this multiple of its group, help is asked; still below a minute later, they break off. Used only while fleet coordination is on.
Ships of the target's faction within this distance of it count as its group.
Max. distance to a target another fleet has
A fleet farther than this from a target another fleet already has leaves it to that fleet. An attack response prefers fleets within this distance.
Min. speed against a target another fleet has
Past the group radius, a fleet slower than this share of the target's speed leaves a target another fleet already has to that fleet. An attack response prefers fleets fast enough.

How much nearer one fleet must be to take a target from another: a fleet nearer than the fleets on a target by this much takes it over, and a target goes to an idle fleet nearer than the asking one by this much. An attack response counts an engaged fleet this much farther away.
Wait for help before breaking off
Fleets whose fight fell below the break-off strength wait this long for help before they break off. Used only while fleet coordination is on.
An open call for help is dropped when no fleet came within this time.
After a response to an attacker, its further attacks send no new response for this time.

A target handed to a fleet stays reserved for it this long while its confirmation is awaited; a lost answer is sent again within it.
A fleet that still reports a target a nearer fleet took from it is told again to break off, if within this time.

Prahové hodnoty citlivosti lodě na přijaté poškození:
Coordinate the fleets in a sector

The fleets on the order in one sector pick their targets together: a target another fleet already handles is left to it, one out of reach or too fast is skipped, a group too strong for one fleet is taken on together or held off. Every fleet reports to the coordinator whether this is on or off; off, each fleet takes its own targets. A fleet with "Share target with other fleets" off keeps its target to itself either way.
Attack responses before a fleet's own targets

When a ship or station of yours is attacked in a sector with fleets on the order, the nearest fleet that may respond goes to the attacker even while it fights a target it picked itself; such a fleet is chosen over an idle one only when nearer by more than the handoff margin. A fleet already answering an attack or helping another fleet keeps its target. Off, only a fleet without a target responds.
